contents.text: This is the first of four things the agent does for every visitor. A guest asks for a sea view and says they're bringing a dog. The agent opens the one room that takes dogs, so the guest lands in the right place.

arguments.question: Shall we carry on through the four things?

choices.label: On to the next stop
choices.why: The booking shown as a card

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick it up any time
